purpose: Q2 parameter-sensitivity evidence package; the delivered main table is not modified

pre_registered_criteria.threshold: for thresholds [0.45, 0.5, 0.55]: jaccard_mean >= 0.5 and at least 40/50 dimensions with overlap >= 2 of 3
pre_registered_criteria.resolution: for resolutions [0.8, 1.0, 1.2]: 40 <= communities <= 80 and largest community < 20% of nodes
pre_registered_criteria.note: criteria were fixed before the sweep and live in src/beer_models/q2_sensitivity.py

baseline_reproduction.check: default parameters (threshold 0.50, resolution 1.0) reproduce the main Q2 Top-3 selection row by row

data_mapping.positional_order: 2.csv row/column order equals 1.csv non-meta column order
data_mapping.note: the brief names 2.csv Pearson; recomputation of 1.csv gives the Spearman matrix (max abs difference ~1e-16)

graph.resolution_parameter: varied over the sweep, fixed at 1.0 in the main table

scope_limits.inference: parameter sensitivity of an associational ranking; no causal claim
scope_limits.main_table_untouched: q2_top3.py defaults and outputs/q2_top3_20261028 are not modified by this package
